title: Transferability Rule
description: A single condition/action rule attached to a reference or calibration artifact: the condition that triggers it (`triggeredBy`), the action(s) that resolve it (`actions` — an OR-set, any one action satisfies the rule), and whether applying one is mandatory (`required`). `triggeredBy` and `actions` draw from the open SKOS vocabulary in bblocks://ogc.focal.transferability.vocab — the values listed in `examples` below are the core, evidenced set from FOCAL's pilot workflows, not an exhaustive enum; new terms may be added to the vocabulary without a schema change.

triggeredBy.description: The condition that triggers this rule.

actions.description: One or more actions, any of which resolves `triggeredBy` — an OR-set, not a required combination (no evidenced case needs more than one action applied simultaneously).

required.description: Whether applying one of `actions` is mandatory once `triggeredBy` holds. Defaults to true. When false, skipping is allowed but degrades result quality/trust rather than blocking execution — describe the consequence in `transferabilityNotes`.
